name: gradient-wide-matrix

frames.best_why: The full stack of stops reads clearly, from pale peach at the bottom to navy at the top.

tagline: Peach, coral and violet stack upward into deep navy across a rounded panel.
summary: A decorative vertical gradient block with many stops: pale pink and peach at the bottom, through coral, rose and violet, ending in deep navy blue at the top.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle filled by a tall vertical gradient: pale pink and peach along the bottom edge, warming through coral and rose, then violet, finishing in a deep navy blue at the top. Black margins frame it.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The seven colour stops are fixed, though classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
use_when: A rich sunset-to-night field is needed behind a headline, card or media block.
avoid_when: Its many fixed stops shift quickly, so mid-tones can make overlaid text hard to read.
customise: The seven gradient stops sit in the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight_why: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.

a11y.note: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it conveys no information on its own.

polish_why: Smooth many-stop blend with clean corners; visually rich but still a stock gradient.
